evidence.C1: The tank is drawn as a glass box with depth haze and shadows, and the cream/green palette is coherent, but fishing and garden screens feel less distinctive than the tank.
evidence.C2: Main actions are findable, such as Feed, Care, Cast, and Test the water, but the fishing screen mixes 'Flick up on the water to cast' with a Cast button, which can confuse first-time players.
evidence.C3: The feature summary includes care, fishing, breeding, scaping, greenhouse, reef genetics, orders, journal, and focus, clearly exceeding a typical cozy aquarium app.
evidence.C4: Components are mostly consistent, but toasts overlap content, such as the desktop tools row and the garden seed shelf.

fixes: Move all toast notifications to a fixed safe area with clear spacing so they never overlap tools, cards, or seed shelf items.
Clarify the fishing flow by unifying the flick gesture and Cast button, and add brief state-specific guidance during casting, striking, and reeling.
Raise the visual distinctiveness of fishing, garden, and journal screens to match the tank, especially scene art, plant illustrations, and empty states.

evidence.C1: Coherent warm cream/green palette, tank has nice glass-box perspective with depth haze and receding gravel, fishing scene has atmospheric rain/night work. However fish art is simple vector shapes rather than distinctive field-guide illustrations.
evidence.C2: Clear tools row (Feed, Care, Scape, Residents, Shop, Photo, Watch, Share), 'More to do' guides new players, Care sheet well-organized with water test/maintenance/heater sections, Journal has clear tabs and filters, phone layout wraps tools to 2 rows with bottom nav.
evidence.C3: Multiple interlocking loops: nitrogen cycle care, 9-spot fishing with flick/strike/reel/tension/drag, breeding with inherited colors, aquascaping (16 plants, 8 hardscape, 3 substrates, 3 tank sizes), greenhouse with variegated sports, reef lab with named strains, 47 species/5 rarities, 18 milestones, focus timer, daily orders, streaks.
evidence.C4: Consistent pill buttons, card-based layout, and cream/green palette across screens. Minor rough edge: 'My first tank is ready' toast overlaps the tank on phone view. States (selected nav, tabs) are consistent.

fixes: Make the fish art more distinctive and detailed — current vector shapes are too simple to be the hero of an aquarium app and the journal silhouettes are generic gray blobs.
Add more visual interest to the tank scene — it feels sparse with only a few small fish; more schooling behavior, varied sizes, or richer plant/hardscape composition would elevate the hero screen.
Fix the 'My first tank is ready' toast positioning on phone so it doesn't overlap the tank artwork, and ensure feedback toasts are consistently placed across viewports.

evidence.C1: Coherent cream/green palette with serif display type and field-guide touches (journal silhouettes, 'Paracheirodon innesi'); but the tank hero reads murky with tiny sparse fish and garden trays are bare grids, so not every screen feels designed.
evidence.C2: Strong guidance everywhere: 'Tap a fish to meet it. Tap the glass and watch who comes.', 'More to do' suggestions, 4-step 'How the greenhouse works', 'Flick up on the water to cast'; minor friction from unexplained 'Stocking 0.5 of 2.2' and jargon-y 'Scape'.
evidence.C3: All anchor loops present and interlocking: 'nitrogen cycle simulation', reel/tension fight with drag, 'tournaments against CPU anglers', 'Breeding with inherited colours', greenhouse cuttings-to-orders, 'reef lab (frag, cross, named strains)', 18 milestones, focus timer; only breadth-within-loop depth keeps it from 10.
evidence.C4: Components and spacing are consistent across screens (pill nav, cards, buttons), but feedback placement is rough: the 'Unlocked: Mountain stream, Mangrove inlet and 5 more' toast covers seed-shelf plant names and 'My first tank is ready' straddles the tank card edge.

fixes: Make the tank the hero: brighten the default state with more/larger fish and richer plant layering so the tank screen looks lively rather than dark and sparse.
Move toasts to a dedicated non-overlapping area (e.g., under the header) so 'Unlocked...' and 'My first tank is ready' never cover cards, plant names, or tool rows.
Clarify cryptic labels: gloss 'Stocking 0.5 of 2.2' (e.g., 'of 2.2 fish capacity') and add a one-line hint for 'Scape'; consider slightly richer tray art in the greenhouse.
